three_specific_mistakes.title: HMAC Clock-Skew Replay Vulnerability
three_specific_mistakes.what_happened: Assumed a 300s timestamp window was secure without recording consumed signatures; allowed an attacker to replay valid approvals.
three_specific_mistakes.technical_lesson: Cryptographic authorization requires a stateful UsedNonceRegistry with TTL cache to guarantee every approval is strictly single-use.

three_specific_mistakes.title: Catastrophic Regex Backtracking (ReDoS) Risk
three_specific_mistakes.what_happened: Constructed credit card pattern with nested quantifiers without length boundaries, creating vulnerability to ReDoS CPU exhaustion.
three_specific_mistakes.technical_lesson: Never run unbounded regexes on raw input; always enforce a 100KB payload gate and use pre-compiled bounded patterns.

three_specific_mistakes.title: Audit Hash Chain Concurrency Forking
three_specific_mistakes.what_happened: Appended audit log records without concurrency locking, creating a race condition where parallel threads could read the same parent hash and fork the chain.
three_specific_mistakes.technical_lesson: All cryptographic chain modifications must be strictly serialized using reentrant thread locks (threading.RLock).
